design_invariants.label: capsule-evidence-is-not-comprehension
design_invariants.statement: A recorded capsule proves which bytes were selected and hashed. It never proves the model read, understood, or obeyed them.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-CAP-1 (v3.0.0 P1): invocation traces recorded surface roles only, so a changed archive at the same path produced an identical trace.
